title: Close Encounters of the Third Kind as informed by real UFO material

tellings.quote: real in Close Encounters of the Third Kind for example you have crates with TRW and locked on them

plain: Steven Spielberg's 1977 film Close Encounters of the Third Kind drew on real UFO material, Michels says, pointing to crates in the film marked TRW and Lockheed, two big defense contractors. Michels offers this as his own reading of the film. If true, Hollywood would have slipped real clues about secret UFO work into the movie.
